scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run format:check --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix frontend
